title: Restricted mean survival time (RMST)
summary: Mean event-free time up to a stated horizon in each arm, and the difference, from the area under the Kaplan-Meier curves.

sizing._why: No RMST form is in the catalog; sizing needs the survival curves up to tau and the censoring pattern and is a simulation.

pinned_defaults: R: summary(survfit(...), rmean = 4): the horizon stated in advance. The default reports no restricted mean, and rmean = 'common' uses the largest observed time, which moves with the data.

Python: the RMST from lifelines' KM fit, but NOT its variance. restricted_mean_survival_time(..., return_variance=True) returns the variance of min(T, tau), the spread of the data (an SE of 1.24 years here), not the variance of the estimate (0.047). The estimate's Greenwood-type variance is written out.
_tau: The horizon must lie within follow-up in both arms and be chosen before seeing the data. The RMST difference needs no proportional-hazards assumption.
